content: The wiki has no control docs. The interact button vocabulary is likely lowercase key names like "e" or "space", or mouse names "left_click". Let me try a small probe plan with several distinct candidates in one pass so I learn the vocabulary cheaply.

args.approach: Probe the input vocabulary cheaply: try interact with lowercase key-style ids ("e", "space") and raw_input with lowercase "e"/"space" on the notice board, so one pass reveals which names the harness accepts before committing to the farming loop.
